description: This shoebox is much messier than Fred's. Loose threads and lint balls are scattered everywhere. Your neighbor, a grumpy old boot, is currently napping in the corner.

floor.description: A floor covered in lint and loose threads.

exit_west.description: The crack leads back to your own shoebox.

edge_n.description: A hole in the ceiling leads up to the Shoe Rack.

exit_east.description: A door leads east out to the garden path.

npc_neighbor.description: A grumpy old boot is snoring loudly.

dialogue.text: "Zzz... keep it down... some of us are trying to hibernate... zzz..."
"You again, Fred? Still screaming at the moon? Bah! And that karaoke party last night was intolerable! When I was your age, we only screamed at things that deserved it, like muddy puddles!"
"If you're looking for your lunch, I saw a suspicious shadow heading toward the south gates. Now bugger off!"

grimy_mirror.onInteract: You stare into the dusty, cracked mirror. A slightly handsome, slightly creased sneaker stares back. Yes, you are definitely a shoe.
grimy_mirror.description: A cracked plastic mirror on the wall. You look... remarkably like a shoe.

lint_pile.description: A huge pile of gray cardboard dust and lint balls. Deep inside, something sparkles!

item.name: Shiny Lint Ball
item.opened_description: A huge pile of gray cardboard dust and lint balls. It is empty.
item.onCollect: You search the lint pile and find a Shiny Lint Ball! It gleams beautifully.

dark_corner.unlitDescription: A pitch black corner of the room. Shadows pool here, hiding whatever lies within.
dark_corner.description: The corner is illuminated. Under the dust, you spot a strange artifact!

conditions.failMessage: It's pitch black. You'll stumble if you try to step in there without a light source.

item.name: Ancient Sock
item.onCollect: You reach into the illuminated alcove and pull out a tattered, ancient sock! It hums with historical starchy resonance!
